profile_text.body:
The material provided for CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is thin and internally inconsistent. The company is recorded as a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading under the ticker CCC, with a CIK of 0001818201. Its listed website is calgoncarbon.com, and the text drawn from that site describes Calgon Carbon as an activated carbon business focused on air and water purification. That text presents FILTRASORB, described as a reagglomerated, coal-based activated carbon, as proven over more than 40 years in applications including TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial settings. The site says FILTRASORB is made in the United States.

No AI products are listed for the company, and no MCP servers are recorded. No lawsuits are recorded either. The only litigation-related fact is a law exposure count of 375 in Illinois.

The site text and the company identity do not line up: the harvested material is about Calgon Carbon and activated carbon products, while the company is named CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. Nothing in the provided facts explains that mismatch, so the AI products and market position of CCC Intelligent Solutions cannot be described from this material.
